sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of Proceeds All of the securities offered
    under this prospectus are being registered for the account of the Selling Stockholders. We will not receive any of
    the proceeds from the sale of these securities pursuant to this prospectus. The shares being offered by the Selling Stockholders
    consist of (i) shares issuable upon exercise of warrants issued to Armistice, (ii) shares issuable upon conversion
    of Series I Convertible Preferred Stock, and (iii) shares issuable upon conversion of Series H Convertible Preferred Stock. We have agreed to pay all costs, expenses and fees
    relating to the registration of the securities covered by this prospectus. The Selling Stockholders will bear all commissions
